inputs.name: cyclicExecution
inputs.description: When TRUE, periodic reading is performed, and trigger has no effect

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: External trigger signal, reads value upon each rising edge

inputs.name: windowSize
inputs.description: The window size for the moving average, which must be between 1 and 100

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset signal, resets the moving average calculation when TRUE

outputs.name: windowSizeReached
outputs.description: FALSE: Maximum window width not yet reached TRUE: Maximum window width has been reached

outputs.name: error
outputs.description: FALSE: No error occurred TRUE: An error occurred during the execution of FB
